Name: No moustache Harvey
Author: aranluc
Description:
I hate Harvey's moustache, so I shaved him. I tried to respect the original design as much as possible, but now he's got full lips and cute dimples. Why not.

It's just the portrait. This works fine with the original sprite because you can't see the moustache in it.
